teacup.name: Tea cup
teacup.caption:
Tea
cup
teacup.description: A pale mint tea cup with tea, steam and a smile. A decorative prop for Ossan.

coffee.name: Coffee cup
coffee.caption:
Coffee
cup
coffee.description: A cream coffee cup with steam, a small heart and a wink.

eraser.name: Eraser
eraser.caption: Eraser
eraser.description: A pale pink eraser in a blue paper sleeve. Decorative only; does not erase.

compass.name: Compass
compass.caption: Compass
compass.description: Blue legs and a brass knob. Decorative only; does not draw circles.

magnifier.name: Magnifying glass
magnifier.caption:
Magnifying
glass
magnifier.description: By Ossan. A magnifying glass with a wooden handle and brass rim. Decorative only; does not magnify.

envelope.name: Sealed envelope
envelope.caption:
Sealed
envelope
envelope.description: By Ossan. A cream envelope with a red wax seal.

antique-key.name: Brass key
antique-key.caption: Brass key
antique-key.description: By Ossan. A slightly tilted antique brass key.

desk-bell.name: Desk bell
desk-bell.caption: Desk bell
desk-bell.description: By Ossan. A silver bell on a dark base. Decorative only; makes no sound.

senpai-robot.name: Robot
senpai-robot.caption: Robot
senpai-robot.description: A small mint robot that winks and quietly watches over the desk for Senpai. Decorative only; has no special functions.

vacant-lot.name: Vacant lot
vacant-lot.caption: Vacant lot
vacant-lot.description: A green frame with a Japanese sign reading “Vacant lot” (空き地), grass and sprouts. Transparent center. Only the frame stretches; the sign and lettering keep their size.

work-in-progress.name: Work in progress
work-in-progress.caption:
Work in
progress
work-in-progress.description: A subtle frame and a wooden sign on legs reading “Work in progress” (作業中) in Japanese. Transparent outside the sign. Only the frame stretches; the sign and lettering keep their size.

temporary-area.name: Temporary area
temporary-area.caption:
Temporary
area
temporary-area.description: A shallow blue-gray tray frame and a Japanese sign reading “Temporary area” (仮置き場). Transparent center. Only the frame stretches; the sign and lettering keep their size.
